bonds.analysis: To build a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only, we will allocate funds across bonds maturing in each of the next five years. This approach ensures a steady cash flow and reduces interest rate risk by diversifying the portfolio's maturity dates. Given the constraints, the proposed allocation will be evenly distributed across the 1-year, 2-year, 3-year, 4-year, and 5-year maturity buckets. Each bucket will hold 20% of the portfolio, ensuring no more than 30% of the portfolio is concentrated in any single maturity year. This laddered structure will also help maintain a portfolio duration of approximately 3 years, well below the 7-year warning limit and 10-year maximum duration constraint.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Based on the sub-agent's analysis, we recommend building a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only. The portfolio will be allocated evenly across bonds maturing in each of the next five years. Each maturity bucket will hold 20% of the portfolio, ensuring a balanced and diversified approach. However, due to the maximum 40% allocation constraint per asset class, the bond allocation is capped at 40%. Therefore, the remaining 60% of the portfolio will be allocated to other asset classes, such as equities and materials, to meet the diversification requirements.
